paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.34 as of 2026-07-30, representing an 8.11 percent increase from the prior close and a 30.84 percent decrease over the last 22 sessions.

The recent news includes an article from The Globe and Mail discussing analyst conflicts on Fermi Inc. and other companies, as well as a press release from PR Newswire about Fermi Inc.'s admission of shares of Common Stock and Total Voting Rights.

There have been various SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers and the disclosure of the resignation of director Miles Everson, as well as the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. There was one Form 4 filing and no Form 144 filings.
